mcp.name: ai.com.mcp/linkedin
mcp.description: LinkedIn API as MCP tools to retrieve profile data and publish content. Powered by HAPI MCP.

profile_text.body:
LinkedIn is a professional networking platform founded in 2003 and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. According to its website, the company serves 1 billion members and describes itself as a space to manage professional identity, build and engage with professional networks, and access knowledge, insights and opportunities. The platform offers features including Open To Work for job seeking, messaging, live videos, stories, and newsletters.

LinkedIn has registered an MCP server (ai.com.mcp/linkedin) that provides LinkedIn API tools to retrieve profile data and publish content, powered by HAPI MCP. The company faces significant legal exposure in California, where it is involved in 220 cases according to the held facts.
